menst.name: menstrual
menst.ctx: Energy often runs low — slowing down is normal.
menst.desc: The lining sheds: this is your period. The body is working, even at rest.
menst.next: Next: the follicular phase — energy climbs back.

foll.name: follicular
foll.desc: Estrogen climbs, a follicle matures. Often the lightest stretch of the cycle.
foll.next: Next: the ovulatory window — the cycle's peak.

ovul.name: ovulatory
ovul.ctx: High energy · ovulation likely around D{ov1}–D{ov2}.
ovul.desc: Estrogen peaks, then the egg is released. A short window where everything culminates.
ovul.next: Next: the luteal phase — energy eases down.

lute.name: luteal
lute.ctx: PMS may be near — protect your sleep.
lute.desc: Progesterone takes over. Late in this phase, PMS can appear: anticipating helps.

today.late: Your cycle is running past its usual window — it happens, we're watching.
today.discovery_ctx: Log your first period and I'll learn your rhythm.
today.discovery_prediction: No prediction yet — I'm discovering your cycle with you.

prediction.confidence_one: {level} confidence · based on your first cycle
prediction.long_or_short: Your cycles fall outside the usual range (21–40 days). If it keeps happening, mentioning it to a doctor can help — no urgency.

sheet.patterns_waiting: {n} more {cycles} and I'll be able to show you your personal patterns.
sheet.patterns_none: Nothing clear in this phase yet — I keep watching.

patterns.from_start: “{symptom}” comes back around D{day}, {k} cycles out of {n}.
patterns.before_period: “{symptom}” comes back at D-{day} before your period, {k} cycles out of {n}.

onboarding.question: When did your last period start?
onboarding.hint: One question only. Everything stays on your device — nothing ever leaves it.

history.title: history
history.empty: Your closed cycles will appear here, ink after ink.
history.edit_hint: tap a day to correct it

settings.title: settings
settings.export_desc: An encrypted file, readable only with your secret phrase.
settings.import_desc: Restore your data from a {ext} file.
settings.passphrase_hint: at least 8 characters — it never leaves this screen
settings.import_merge_note: Your current data is kept; if a date exists on both sides, your local log wins.
settings.import_error: couldn't read this file — wrong secret phrase or invalid file
settings.backup_nudge: Two cycles of ink already — an encrypted export would keep them safe.
settings.erase_desc: Deletes cycles, logs and settings from this device. Permanent.
settings.about_text: {app} lives entirely on your device: no account, no server, no trackers. Verifiable in your browser's dev tools — zero network requests after load.
settings.disclaimer: {app} is not a medical device and cannot be used for contraception. Predictions are estimates based on your history.
